verdict.rationale: Brex's first-party docs describe AI agents that write memos, fetch receipts, categorize spend, and audit expenses against policy with risk levels. The expenses API auto-matches uploaded receipts to expenses. However, duplicate detection and expense-fraud catching are not documented first-party; only a community comment mentions fraud/risk AI, and that is framed around underwriting. The audit agent is described only as flagging policy violations. Missing for 10: documented duplicate-expense detection, documented fraud detection on expenses, explicit detail on receipt reading/OCR for card expenses, independent hands-on corroboration of AI coding accuracy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI codes and audits expenses for me — reading receipts, suggesting categories and memos, and catching duplicates or fraud

citations.quote: AI assistants do employees' expenses for them, writing memos, fetching receipts, offering policy help, even filing reimbursements automatically.
Stop waiting for people to categorize, review, or approve spend. Let AI agents do it instantly, based on your policies and with total transparency.
Your audit agent monitors company expenses according to your internal processes and categorizes potential violations by risk level.
